title: 100-Mode 10x10 Gaussian Grid
intuition: Iconic Law 1 representational-geometry benchmark: learn all 100 tightly separated 2D Gaussian clusters (10x10 grid, 33.3-sigma valleys) scored on clean live outputs with strict precision (>= 0.97-0.99), balanced mass, and accurate per-mode covariance on an untouched holdout.
failure_mode: Unimodal continuous priors hit the super-exponential Borell-TIS Lipschitz cliff, producing heavy valley bridge mass (24%-54% precision vs >= 97% required) and thin or empty clusters.
protocol_notes: Tier-2 required benchmark and Law 1 anchor (7,000 updates, clean live weights, untouched holdout gate).
